entities.summary: Norway is a sovereign nation in Northern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Oslo. Official languages include Norwegian (Bokmål and Nynorsk). Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy. Population: approximately 5.6 million. Area: 385,207 km². Comprehensive index for Norway covering Viking Age (793-1066, exploration/raids/settlements), Harald Fairhair unification (~872), Christianisation (Olaf Tryggvason/Olaf II), Kalmar Union (1397-1523), Danish-Norwegian union (1523-1814), union with Sweden (1814-1905), independence 1905, WWII (German occupation, Quisling, resistance), oil discovery (1969, North Sea), EU referenda rejection (1972, 1994), NATO founding member, and sovereign wealth fund.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Norway's unification under Harald Fairhair in ~872 and its subsequent Christianisation had significant regional impact. The country's oil discovery in 1969 and rejection of EU referenda in 1972 and 1994 also showcased its distinct national identity.
